shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
cat next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx tsconfig.json; git diff package.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -50
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -ril "cacheComponents" . | head -30; echo ---; find . -iname "*cache*" | head; find . -iname "*connection*"; find . -iname "*random*"

grep -o '<nav>[^<]*</nav>' .next/server/app/index.html; grep -c 'Request [0-9a-f-]\{36\} generated' .next/server/app/index.html; grep -o 'Loading request details[^<]*' .next/server/app/index.html | head -1
(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
for i in 1 2; do curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Request [0-9a-f-]*<!-- --> generated at <!-- -->[^<]*' ; done
pkill -f "next start" || true

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 5; for i in 1 2; do curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -oE 'Request <!-- -->[0-9a-f-]{36}<!-- --> generated at <!-- -->[^<]*<!-- --> \(sample <!-- -->[0-9.]+' ; done; pkill -f "next start"; true
git status --short && git diff tsconfig.json && grep -rn "instant" app/ components/ || echo "no instant opt-outs"
